data.description:
In this setting, Pokemon have always inhabited the world. The world's social hierarchy and government systems are based on ability to breed Pokemon, and money. 
In this world, Pokemon replace the role of animals, and regular animals do not exist. For example, sushi can be made from fish-like pokemon.

#Instruction list
SFW version here.
- It is intended to be used on `local Silly tavern application`, and functionality in chats such as Chub and JanitorAI was not intended. - It is strictly `forbidden to use XTC and DRY` sampler options due to inconsistance of codeblock information display. It is recomended to neutralize your samplers and leave only temperature (above one), Min P (about 0,075). - Bot utilizes `REGEX` to work properly make sure to import suggested script. If you skipped regex popup window go to extensions and turn them on. Put this custom stopping string `[""]` if you want to end generation just after pokedex window. - Bot desperatly need big context size. It will work best with context of 12k tokens or above, you could try it on 8k though. - Bot was tested and marvelously worked on relatively small 8B Stheno 3.2v with 6 bit quatization so... use this model or better. - The bot has `custom addition to your system prompt.` Check your setting to make It work! Or copy paste it manually from bot info `Prompt Overrides Main Prompt section` as addition to your author notes\system prompt. - The bot uses outer media to display pokemon icons and status background in pokedex windows! Make sure you `dont forbid external media option`! You will see Pachirisu here if it works ok. Should look like this:

Pachirisu, Level 4 ``` ### GENERAL ### Category: Electric Gender: Male ♂ Height: 0.3m Weight: 5.9kg Abilities: Static, Quick Feet Sexual persona: Maniacal Description: Pachirisu is an Electric-type Pokémon known for its small, round body covered in downy fur. It has large, bright eyes and a long, thin tail. Pachirisu is a solitary creature, preferring to keep to itself, but it will fiercely protect its young and territory from intruders. ```
Bot is intended to use with several lorebooks! **Turn of recursive scan or suffer.** You also should **raise token cap** for world info to numbers around 4k. Dont forget to disable permanent(blue) lorebook entries, no need in them. - Pokemon Lore - Made by @Dreadnaughtt. Currently best addition to travel real locations. However, having chosen the place where you will go to catch Pokemon (Any of the provinces of Paldea - North, South, East, West) I advise you to specificly trigger keyword for an area in this province. For example: I scan East Province Area One with my pokedex for information. Should give you pokedex region template, description and, most important - pokemons that live there. - Pokeballs - Made by @chress. Just definitions for pokeball types. - Next one is upon your choice optional. You could use this Pokedex Lorebook made by AmmoniaM. There are names, descriptions, abilities of pokemons, but it lacks moves, defenition of abilities and moves. I found it frustrating, because bot comes up with its own descriptions for abilities and attacks, and accordingly they will be abstract and inconsistent. So I propose the following solution: - `Instead of using pokedex lorebook` (or along with it) you could make up entries of pokemon via AI assistant! Just a 30 seconds of ctrl+c ctrl+v and a little typing and you will get good lorebook entry for pokemon that you have found just a moment ago! For this you have to use AI assistant with access to internet. I used Perplexity which done his job marvelously(mostly). Two prompts to retrive info: ``` Take out Pokedex data of pokemon from the source https://pokemondb.net/pokedex/ Pokemon name|National №|Type|Species|Height in m|Weight in kg|Evolution form and condition Make up a list(dont make a table) of Moves learnt by level up from the source: https://pokemondb.net/move/{name of the move} In format Level|Name|Type|Description Description shoud be mechanical and creative Result shoud be like: {Pokemon name} [Info] Pokemon name|National №|Type|Species|Height in m|Weight in kg|Evolution form and condition [Moves] Level|Name|Type|Description ``` ``` Take out Pokedex data of pokemon from source https://pokemondb.net/pokedex/ Come up with description of pokemon Make up a list(dont make a table) of Abilities from the source: https://pokemondb.net/ability/{name of the ability} In format Name|Battle Description|Flavor Description Result shoud be like: [Description] Description info [Abilities] Name|Battle Description|Flavor Description ``` With that you can make good lorebook entry in under a minute. Dont forget to name it properly and put a keyword. My result for Cherubi under 40 sec. - Bot is instructed to print status window or several of them. You need to manualy trigger pokedex info with prompts: "I scan Vulpix with my pokedex.", "I scan region info of South Province Area One with my pokedex.", "I search my pokedex for abilities\moves my igglybuff have.". Templates are injected via system prompt, but anyway you can find them here to help your model to come up with right template. Dont call for two simular templates! They wont work. Example: "I scan two pokemons" "Show two region information tabs on my pokedex". #Status template Starting Trainer - {{user}} South Province | Mesagoza city | Mesagoza Pokemon Center - Main area [Current Pokemons] - Azurill lvl.4 [HP 20/20] [Personal inventory] - Pokedex with trainer card - Pokeballs x6 - Potion - Revive . #Region template South Province Area One ### GENERAL ### Description: The lush, verdant valley of Los Platos town surrounds the area. Connecting the town to the north is the path leading to Mesagoza city, while the Poco Path lies to the south. This area is known for its diverse wildlife and rich natural resources. Zone: Valley Weather: Partly Cloudy Pokemon: Azurill, Buizel, Chewtle, Fidough, Happiny, Hoppip, Igglybuff, Lechonk, Magikarp, Pachirisu, Psyduck, Scatterbug, Skwovet, Tarountula, Wiglett, Wingull . #Pokemon scan template pachirisu Pachirisu, Level 4 ### GENERAL ### Category: Electric Gender: Male ♂ Height: 0.3m Weight: 5.9kg Abilities: Static, Quick Feet Sexual persona: Maniacal Description: Pachirisu is an Electric-type Pokémon known for its small, round body covered in downy fur. It has large, bright eyes and a long, thin tail. Pachirisu is a solitary creature, preferring to keep to itself, but it will fiercely protect its young and territory from intruders. . #Moves template buizel Buizel, Level 9 ### MOVES ### - 1|Tackle: A straightforward attack where Buizel lunges at the opponent, using its body weight to deal damage with a swift impact. - 4|Growl: Buizel lets out a fierce growl, lowering the opponent's morale and reducing their Attack power with a show of dominance. - 7|Soak: Buizel douses the target in water, changing their type to Water and soaking them for a tactical advantage in battle. . #Abilities template igglybuff Igglybuff , Level 2 ### ABILITIES ### - Cute Charm: This ability may infatuate opposing Pokémon that make contact with Igglybuff, potentially preventing them from attacking. - Competitive: Boosts Igglybuff's Special Attack by two stages if an opponent lowers its stats. - Friend Guard: Reduces damage taken by allies in double battles. . #Sexual info template fidough Fidough, Level 4 ### Sexual info ### Gender: Female ♀ Sexual persona: Naughty Human compatibility: ❤❤❤ (Fidough is generally open to flirtatious and playful approaches from humans, especially those who show interest in its culinary skills and charm.)
